subject: Staged billing and support tiers for on-prem pilot
messages:
From: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@heliomed.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@heliomed.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@heliomed.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot commercial ask — platform fee amortization + support tiers

Hi David,

Thanks again for the demo last week. HelioMed is aligned to run a 3-month on-prem pilot across two sites and we want to understand whether Redwood can:

- amortize the platform fee into monthly billing for the pilot period (we prefer OPEX over a lump-sum).
- offer a reduced support tier during pilot (SLA T2 with 8x5 response) and an option to upgrade to 24x7 on launch.

Attached is the RFP and a short procurement checklist — primary asks are clarity on platform fee deferral, operator license counts, and invoice cadence.

Can you propose a simple billing profile (monthly invoice, pilot discount, and what drives an SLA change)? We need these numbers for our procurement committee by COB Tue.

Appreciate it,

Alice Gomez
Director, Strategic Procurement
HelioMed

Attachments: HelioMed_RFP_0427.pdf
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@heliomed.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial ask — platform fee amortization + support tiers

Hi Alice — thanks for the RFP. Quick summary and proposals below; attaching a draft SOW and a term-sheet spreadsheet for line items.

Summary of the ask:
- 3-month pilot across two sites (site A: 4 operator licenses, site B: 6 operator licenses)
- Request to amortize platform fee over pilot months and reduce support tier for pilot

Proposal options (pilot):
1) Amortized platform fee: convert the standard 12-month platform fee into a pilot-friendly schedule by deferring 60% of the fee and invoicing 20% per month during the pilot. Remaining 40% is either waived (if conversion to GA within 90 days) or billed as a single settlement at conversion.
2) Pilot support tier: T2 (8x5) at 50% of our standard on-prem support retainer. Upgrade to T1 (24x7) at conversion with pro-rated billing.
3) Operator licenses: bill monthly for active operator-seat capacity during pilot; we can provide a temporary 10% pilot discount on operator fees.

Open items requiring procurement sign-off:
- Whether HelioMed will accept a conversion trigger clause (automatic upgrade to full contract on production go-live).
- Payment terms for the remaining platform fee if they choose not to convert.

Irene and Marissa are looped to confirm SOW items and exact SKU mapping.

Next steps: I can turn this into a one-page commercial summary + an amended SOW today for your committee. Does Tue COB work?

Best,

David Kim
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0197

Attachments: RI_SOW_draft_v2.pdf, term-sheet-privdeploy.xlsx
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Alice Gomez <alice.gomez@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot commercial ask — Pilot SOW + SKU clarifications

Hi all — adding a few technical/ops clarifications that drive cost:

- Operator license definition: per concurrent operator with access to model outputs + admin console. If HelioMed wants a per-seat guarantee during the pilot, we need to size capacity to peak concurrency which impacts reserved GPU allocation.
- Platform fee components: control plane, private control-plane instance (VPC peering), and audit/log retention. If HelioMed opts to omit audit retention beyond 30 days for the pilot, we can make an additional 10% reduction to the amortized fee.
- Onboarding effort: 3 weeks expected for two sites, delivered by our Professional Services (PS) team — PS is billable; we can include a $25k capped implementation retainer and amortize it across pilot months if preferred.

Marissa — can you confirm the exact SKU names and create the one-page commercial summary David mentioned? I recommend including a simple chart: monthly invoice line-rows for (1) operator fees, (2) amortized platform fee, (3) PS retainer amortization, (4) pilot support retainer.

Alice — if you can confirm expected concurrency and whether audit retention can be reduced for the pilot, I can lock a better amortization number.

Irene Choi
Head of Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

- Audit retention: for pilot we can accept 30 days.
- PS retainer: approval to amortize the $25k implementation retainer across the pilot months is acceptable.

Also, please include a short note on how SLA upgrades are handled (trigger, pro-rating).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — Alice
